faq.question: Is file compression safe?
faq.answer: Yes, our compression is completely safe. All processing happens locally in your browser using client-side technologies. Your files never leave your device, ensuring maximum privacy and security.

faq.question: Will compression reduce file quality?
faq.answer: Our smart compression algorithms are designed to maintain visual quality while reducing file size. You can choose from different quality levels to balance size reduction with quality preservation.

faq.question: What file formats do you support?
faq.answer: We support all major formats including PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP for images; PDF for documents; and MP4, MOV, AVI for videos. More formats are added regularly.

faq.question: How much can file sizes be reduced?
faq.answer: Compression ratios vary by file type and content. Images can typically be reduced by 60-90%, PDFs by 30-70%, and videos by 40-80% depending on the original quality and settings used.

faq.question: Are there any file size limits?
faq.answer: Our browser-based compression works best with files under 100MB for optimal performance. Larger files may take longer to process but are still supported.

faq.question: Can I compress multiple files at once?
faq.answer: Currently, we focus on single-file compression for the best quality results. Batch compression features are planned for future updates.
